reader_summary.overview: Summary: In this episode of the Special Situations Report, hosts Asif and Tamanna Suria discuss the latest developments in the event-driven investing world. The episode begins with a discussion of multiple deals in the works – including Brad Jacob’s newest bid for the construction products company GMS (and a potential rival bid from Home Depot) and briefly covers the since-squashed rumor that Shell would acquire its rival BP..

key_points.text: Summary: In this episode of the Special Situations Report, hosts Asif and Tamanna Suria discuss the latest developments in the event-driven investing world.
Another important M&A headline covered in this episode include the closing of the Regulus and Novartis deal.
The episode continues by breaking down the dilemna bondholders of Warner Bros Discovery faced regarding the planned spinoff and covers a large buyback at Vivek Ramaswamy’s Roivant..
